why-us.heroText: Fewer surprises, clearer decisions and accountable execution.

items.title: One coordinated team

items.title: Clear specifications

sections.heading: How we work
sections.intro: A practical process keeps the project moving. The exact sequence and deliverables are confirmed in your project proposal and agreement.

items.title: Discovery & brief
items.text: We understand your property, family requirements, preferred style, priorities, timeline and investment range through a video consultation.

items.title: Site review & planning
items.text: We review available drawings, dimensions, site conditions and photographs. A physical site visit or measurement exercise is arranged where required.

items.title: Design & specification
items.text: We develop the agreed design direction, layouts, material palette and relevant 3D views, then document selections for approval.

items.title: Costing & agreement
items.text: You receive a detailed scope, specifications, exclusions, payment milestones, target schedule and variation process before execution.

items.title: Execution & updates
items.text: Our team coordinates the agreed work and shares progress updates. Key decisions and changes are recorded for your approval.

items.title: Inspection & handover
items.text: We review completed work against the agreed scope, list pending corrections and coordinate handover after applicable closure requirements.

sections.heading: Confidence comes from what is documented
sections.intro: Trust should not depend on verbal assurances. Before work begins, we aim to establish a clear record of decisions and responsibilities.

items.title: Project scope
items.text: Written list of included works, exclusions, client-supplied items and assumptions.

items.title: Materials & finishes
items.text: Specifications, brands or approved equivalents, finish references and sample approvals as applicable.

items.title: Cost & payments
items.text: Itemised or stage-wise costing, taxes, payment milestones and written approval for variations.

items.title: Progress visibility
items.text: Agreed cadence for photographs, videos, progress notes and decisions requiring your input.

items.title: Quality & handover
items.text: Review against the agreed scope, punch-list of pending items and handover documentation where applicable.

sections.heading: For NRIs and overseas homeowners
